crossRefs.note: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.
Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.
A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.
The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil…
for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.
Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart…
Yahweh smelled the pleasant aroma. Yahweh said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake…
The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it?
You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth…

translations.web: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.
translations.bsb: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver, but the heart of the wicked has little worth.
translations.kjv: The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.
translations.asv: The tongue of the righteous is as choice silver: The heart of the wicked is little worth.
